name: agentic-sdlc
description: Agentic SDLC: a conductor plus 10 phase plugins that take a feature from idea to deployment with human approval gates.

plugins.name: sdlc-core
plugins.description: Backbone of the Agentic SDLC: a conductor that routes work through 10 phases, a state file that remembers where every project stands, human approval gates, and hooks that stop phases being skipped.

plugins.name: sdlc-discovery
plugins.description: Phase 1 of the Agentic SDLC: interviews you about an idea and produces a problem brief with hypothesis, success metric, constraints and scope.

plugins.name: sdlc-requirements
plugins.description: Phase 2 of the Agentic SDLC: turns an approved problem brief into user stories with testable EARS-style acceptance criteria, reviewed by a requirements-reviewer agent.

plugins.name: sdlc-design
plugins.description: Phase 3 of the Agentic SDLC: drafts a technical design and ADRs from approved requirements by reading the real codebase, then has a design-reviewer agent challenge it.

plugins.name: sdlc-planning
plugins.description: Phase 4 of the Agentic SDLC: breaks an approved design into small, sequenced, traceable tasks with definitions of done, ready for sprint planning and optional Jira/Linear sync.

plugins.name: sdlc-build
plugins.description: Phase 5 of the Agentic SDLC: implements one planned task at a time with tests first, small diffs, traceable commits and a PR, keeping a build log.

plugins.name: sdlc-qa
plugins.description: Phase 6 of the Agentic SDLC: derives test cases from acceptance criteria, automates them, runs them, and reports coverage and gaps back into requirements.

plugins.name: sdlc-review
plugins.description: Phase 7 of the Agentic SDLC: AI first-pass pull request review against requirements and design, plus an OWASP-based security checklist, ending in a human merge sign-off.

plugins.name: sdlc-release
plugins.description: Phase 8 of the Agentic SDLC: release planning with feature flags, staged rollout and rollback, business-facing release notes, and a CI/CD pipeline fixer.

plugins.name: sdlc-ops
plugins.description: Phase 9 of the Agentic SDLC: post-release monitoring summaries and incident root-cause analyses that feed follow-up acceptance criteria back into requirements.

plugins.name: sdlc-knowledge
plugins.description: Phase 10 of the Agentic SDLC: captures retrospectives and delivery metrics, and turns agreed lessons into standing rules in CLAUDE.md so every future agent follows them.
